item.source: Spirit City Raid Hard (reported); exact drop route still listed TBA on some guides

item.name: Promise Ring
item.passiveEffect: Every 20 total stacks of Bleed in this unit's range: summon a Bat Spirit at this unit's position (Capacity: 3). Bat Spirits deal 25% of this unit's current damage per attack and despawn after 3 attacks.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Cursed Student exclusive that turns stacked Bleed in range into short-lived Bat Spirit summons.

item.name: Technique Amplifier
item.passiveEffect: Apply Slow based on the current attack: Explode 20%, Blast Away 35%, Twist 50%, Crush 65%.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Salmon Sorcerer exclusive that adds attack-linked Slow values on top of SPA and range rolls.

item.name: Hell's Flower
item.passiveEffect: If an enemy with Burn stops ticking within this unit's range, convert 1 burn application into Austere Flames dealing 85% of this unit's current damage. Austere Flames instances from Radial Flames do not stack.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Hollow exclusive that converts ending Burn ticks in range into a single Austere Flames burst.

item.name: Emperor's Attire
item.passiveEffect: On applying Burn, spread Burn to the 5 nearest enemies that do not already have Burn.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.

item.name: Webbed Fruit
item.passiveEffect: Every 5 regular attacks cocoon enemies. Cocooned enemies are stunned for 10 hits or 5 seconds. If the cocoon breaks after 10 hits, deal 125% of this unit's current damage. If it is not broken before 5 seconds, the cocoon despawns.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: String Demon exclusive that cocoons enemies every few attacks for control or a break burst.

item.name: Boulder
item.passiveEffect: Summon a Stone Wall every 12 seconds (Capacity: 2). In Base Form the wall has 75% of this unit's current damage as health. In Giant Form the wall has 50% of this unit's current damage as health.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Lady Giant exclusive that periodically spawns Stone Walls with form-based health scaling.

item.name: Calamity's Eye

item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Puppet exclusive that spawns a durable Doll when marked enemies die.

item.name: Elven Battle Staff
item.passiveEffect: Arcane Spells count as Follow-Up Attacks. At 3 charges cast Old Magic (line AoE at 100% current damage). At 5 charges cast Eruption (circle AoE at 125% current damage and Mana Burn). At 7 charges cast Storm (full AoE at 150% current damage).
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped.
item.cardSummary: Elf Mage exclusive that turns charge thresholds into stronger follow-up Arcane Spells.

item.name: Spirit of the Moonblade
item.passiveEffect: This unit gains permanent buffs after attacking different enemy types. For each enemy type attacked: increase Damage by 10% and Critical Chance by 10%.

item.name: Hair Bells
item.passiveEffect: Demonic Presence: enemies within 50% of this unit's range take 15% of this unit's current damage every 1 second. Savage Rebound: when this unit is stunned, immediately cleanse the stun and perform a Follow-Up Attack (Thunderclap Cut) at 125% of current damage. All of this unit's Follow-Up Attacks apply Dismembered.

item.name: Hexed Blade
item.passiveEffect: On Upgrade 3, summon a Winged Spirit at this unit's position that circles at 50% of this unit's range. The Winged Spirit deals 75% of this unit's current damage every 5 seconds at its current location and applies Stun.
item.notes: Unit-locked. Most exclusive gear requires the unit's evolved form before it can be equipped. No Story map drop is listed; craft-focused.
item.cardSummary: Shadow exclusive craft piece that summons a circling Winged Spirit after Upgrade 3.
